integrity: The linear-order-s Taylor polynomial is not represented as nonlinear-order-s Runge-Kutta for s>4; no independent evaluation or publication is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sufficiency of the forward-Euler bound is known from general SSP work. New scope is fixed-network necessity under the explicit walk-gap condition. No full classification for graphs without a walk gap. A specialized equivalent graph theorem might exist.
title: A path-parity certificate for sharp positivity loss in Taylor diffusion
